terms.title: Sound capture
terms.description: Recording voices and instruments with microphones; microphone placement and input gain.

terms.title: Audio editing
terms.description: Cutting recorded clips, removing unwanted noise and arranging recorded sound on a timeline.

terms.title: Mixing
terms.description: Balancing instrument and vocal volumes, equalization, panning and combining tracks into a stereo mix.

excerpts.text: Place the microphone close to the singer and set input gain before recording the voice.
Choose a microphone position that captures the acoustic guitar without clipping the recording.
Cut out unwanted clicks from the recorded clip and rearrange the pieces on the timeline.
Remove background hiss from recorded dialogue and trim silent sections of the clip.
Balance vocal and instrument levels, pan tracks left and right and equalize the stereo mix.
Adjust each track volume until the singer and instruments blend in the final stereo mix.
